join.title: Choose your plan and reserve your place
join.intro: Fill in your details and we will then show you the payment details and a reference code for your order. Nothing is charged automatically: you make the transfer yourself, and we check it ourselves.
join.unlistedNote: This plan is not offered publicly — you reached it through a direct link.
join.railNote: Choose how you will pay. The account details are deliberately not shown on this page — they appear once your order is recorded.
join.ageConfirm: I am 18 years old or older.
join.ageWhy: Membership is for adults only, and the reason is specific: your voice recordings are published to your level's channel inside the community, and are sent to external speech-analysis services. We are not set up to handle a parent or guardian's consent, so we do not accept anyone under 18.

fields.name: Full name
fields.contactHint: The number we will confirm on and follow up with. Include your country code.

join.afterSubmit: Nothing has been charged yet. The next page is where the transfer details are.

errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Try again, and if it keeps happening message us on WhatsApp.
errors.rate: Too many attempts in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.invalid: Some details are missing or unreadable. Check the fields and try again.
errors.currency: That payment method does not match the currency. Please choose again.
errors.tier: That plan is not available on the payment path you chose.
errors.term: Choose a billing term: monthly or annual.
errors.rail: Choose one of the available payment methods.
errors.name: Please enter your full name.
errors.contact: Please enter a WhatsApp number we can reach you on.
errors.rail_unavailable: No payment method is available right now. Message us on WhatsApp and we will arrange it manually.
errors.storage: We could not record your order, and nothing was charged. Try again, and if it keeps happening message us on WhatsApp.
errors.age: You must confirm you are 18 or older. Membership is for adults only.

confirm.title: Your order is recorded
confirm.intro: Keep the reference code to hand: write it in the transfer note, and it is how we know the money belongs to your order.
confirm.referenceNote: Put it in the notes field when you transfer. Without it, checking takes longer.
confirm.amountExact: Transfer exactly the amount shown. Any difference holds the order until we have spoken.
confirm.amountConverted: The account is in AED and the amount above is in dollars. Your bank does the conversion, so the amount that arrives may differ slightly from this figure — we accept the equivalent. A small difference is not a problem.
confirm.amountStable: The amount above is in dollars, and one USDT equals one dollar. Send that same figure. Network fees are yours, so allow for them and make sure the full amount arrives.

railSteps.vodafoneCash: Open the wallet app, choose transfer to wallet, and enter the number above.
railSteps.instapay: Open InstaPay or your bank's app and transfer to the payment address above.
railSteps.paypal: Send the amount to the account above and put the reference code in the note.
railSteps.bankTransfer: Transfer from your bank to the details above. International transfers usually take one to three business days.
railSteps.crypto: Send to the address above on exactly the network named. Any other network means the funds are lost and we cannot recover them.

confirm.proofIntro: Once you have transferred, upload a picture of the receipt. A screenshot is enough.
confirm.proofNote: The image is stored in a locked location on the server, never on a public page, and only the person doing the check sees it.
confirm.proofDone: We have your receipt. We check it ourselves and reply on WhatsApp.
confirm.proofReplace: If you uploaded the wrong image, upload the right one and we will use the most recent.
confirm.manualNote: Checking is done by a person, not automatically, so there is a short gap between your transfer and your access. We would rather say so than have you wonder.
confirm.helpNote: Send us the reference code and we will find your order straight away.
confirm.railUnavailable: That payment method is not configured on our side right now. Message us on WhatsApp and we will take the transfer manually.
confirm.notFoundBody: Check that you copied the whole reference code, or start a new order.

errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.nofile: No image was chosen. Pick the receipt image and try again.
errors.toolarge: That image is too large. Send a screenshot rather than the original file.
errors.badtype: That file is not an image we can open. Send a screenshot instead.
errors.already: This order has already been checked, so a second receipt is not needed.
errors.storage: We could not save the receipt. Try again, and if it keeps happening send it to us on WhatsApp.

admin.title: Membership orders
admin.signInIntro: This page is for whoever checks transfers.
admin.provisionNote: These two steps are done by hand in two different systems. This page only reminds you of them, it does not perform them — writing wrongly into the student database is far worse than a manual step.
admin.provisionDiscord: Lift the suspension on the student's record in the bot's data.
admin.provisionPortal: Set the student's available stages in the portal.

errors.unconfigured: No access token is configured on the server, so this page is locked for everyone.
errors.illegal_transition: That transition is not allowed from the order's current status.
errors.invalid: That order does not exist, or the details are unreadable.
errors.failed: The action failed. Check the server log.
